newsitem.title: USA: Foreign crudes elude U.S. buyers, Latam trade up.
newsitem.headline: Foreign crudes elude U.S. buyers, Latam trade up.

text.p: Foreign crudes still eluded U.S. buyers Friday as a result of the narrow trans-Atlantic arbitrage, but traders cited moderate activity in Latin America.
The Jan West Texas Intermediate/Brent spread was running at 65-70 cents late in the day, up around 10 cents from Thursday in the wake of the Dec Brent contract expiry on the London IPE.
"It's very difficult to make things work into the Gulf Coast right now," one trader said. "Buyers and sellers are too far apart."
